feeds.title: Private Eye
feeds.description: Private Eye magazine offers a unique blend of humour, social and political observations and investigative journalism. Subscribe to get latest updates from this magazine in your inbox.

feeds.title: News Biscuit
feeds.description: NewsBiscuit was launched by John O'Farrell with the noble aims of eradicating global poverty, creating a lasting peace in the Middle East and providing a daily dose of humour to bored people at work.

feeds.title: The Sleaze
feeds.description: The Sleaze is a UK based satire and humour site. The Sleaze offers an uncompromising, off beat and savage view of our world with British Political Satire, News Satire, Pop Culture Satire, Religious Satire, Royal Satire, Crime Satire, Weird Satire News Parody and Surreal Humour.

feeds.title: Funny Women
feeds.description: The UK's leading community for female comedy helping women to perform, write and do business with humour. Subscribe to keep up with the latest articles from this blog.

feeds.title: Never Mind The Bedsocks
feeds.description: Never Mind The Bedsocks is a humor blog for mid-life souls battling existential crises. The blog is run by a 50-something cartoon character named Carla Fandango who aims to celebrate the Gen X years and save our generation from obscurity & persuade aging alternative types to take life less seriously with entertainment, laughs, and food for thought in equal measure.

feeds.title: UK Cop Humour
feeds.description: UK Cop Humour was founded all the way back in 2012 as a result of constant Police-bashing perpetrated by certain sections of the media. Our aim is to remind everyone that the Police are the Public and the Public are the Police and break down any barriers that exist, where possible, through humour and positivity. Subscribe to keep up with latest articles from this blog.

feeds.title: The Daily WTF
feeds.description: The Daily WTF (also called Worse Than Failure from February to December 2007) is a humorous blog dedicated to 'Curious Perversions in Information Technology'. Subscribe to keep up with latest updates from this blog.

feeds.title: M T McGuire Authorholic
feeds.description: M T McGuire is a humorous fantasy fiction author. Her books are quite funny too. Subscribe to keep track of new posts from this blog.
